name: es.startups-espanolas/notas-de-prensa
title: Startups Españolas press desk
description: For agencies and PR teams: submit press releases, find published ones, get live URLs for reports.

tools.name: ver_medios
tools.description: Lists the active publications of the network with name, URL, topics covered, what each accepts and the link to its criteria page. Read only.

tools.name: ver_condiciones
tools.description: Returns the terms: free allowance, package prices, labelling of paid and free releases, what is not published, how the process works. Read only. Call before enviar_nota.

tools.name: enviar_nota
tools.description: For agencies and communications teams: submit a press release, follow its status and get the published URL for the client report. We email a confirmation request to the given sender address; the review starts only after that email is answered. Publication is an editorial decision, not guaranteed. Free allowance and packages apply per sender address (see ver_condiciones). Moves no money.

email.description: Email address of the agency or company that sends the release. It receives the confirmation request, offers and invoices.

empresa.description: Company the release is about (max 120 characters).

texto.description: Full text of the release, 400 to 20,000 characters, plain text or simple paragraphs.

medio_preferido.description: Preferred publication; only a hint, the editorial review decides.

tools.name: buscar_notas
tools.description: Finds press releases already published by the network for a company or website domain (title, publication, date, URL, how it is labelled), for example to document where a client appeared. Public information only, at most 20 results, newest first. Read only.

empresa.description: Company name or part of it (at least 3 characters).

dominio.description: Website domain of the company, e.g. example.com (optional if empresa is given).

desde.description: Only releases published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (optional).

tools.name: estado_nota
tools.description: Status of a submission by ticket: waiting for confirmation, in review, published (with URL), rejected, answered by email, waiting for payment, expired. Read only.
